answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 37216 Country: India Title: They have a child girl of 9 years old, who has got more right on the child father or mother? Does the father have the right to demand for the child? Question: They have a child girl of 9 years old, who has got more right on the child father or mother? Does the father have the right to demand for the child? Answer ID: 37216 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 455/455/M=1433) The mother is responsible for the nourishment of daughter upto 9 years of age while the expenses shall be born by the father. After 9 years, the father can take the daughter in her custody. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
